reviews.x: False advertising. I feel a bit duped. These are not a fine mist spray. This was the specific reason that I purchased these bottles and I used them for the first time today, and sure enough- it was a thick stream of fluid! Not a mist at all! Not even a little bit. I want my money back but amazon will make me return and that is an even bigger waste of my time considering the ups store is a half hour away. Stupid. Very disappointing. These are not flimsy, and the sprayer is much much better than I had anticipated.  Perfect size for flights (3 oz. each).  Currently using for liquid hand sanitizer in our cars.  Not happy to buy more from China however......
Tops do not fit tight and continue to fall off.

These are packaged well for shipping. They are a quality plastic not the lightweight flimsy plastic. The spray is a mist and works well for the hand sanitizer i put in them. There were two clear ,one pink and one blue bottle. I don’t th8nk they will leak under normal use. They didn’t leak when I shook them upside down!
i dropped  the perfume mist and that spray didn't work. so i looked for a replacement. this spray bottle is an upgrade. it is really nice.
Perfect for disinfection solution when traveling. Use it to disinfect my luggage and hotel room

These are nifty little mist bottles. I'm personally using them for rubbing alcohol to store in my purse. During these times of COVID- it's another way of staying sanitary and safe when going to my doctor appointments and to the store. However, the top doesn't stay on and there is leaking from the pumper area. In addition, it took awhile for me to get a bottle to work (spray) which made me check all the others. Overall, I need the product, but it needs some improvements. Simple and gets the job d

reviews.t: Pretty, sturdy travel bottles well worth the price - would recommend & buy again
reviews.x: Very happy with this order! Shipping was fast and the item was well packed. These seemed to be sturdier than what you might buy in the travel section of your local mart or pharmacy. The colors are very pretty in person and the bottles produce a nice even mist. I plan to take these on camping/lake/float trips over the summer!

reviews.t: It is not a fine mist sprayer
reviews.x: Unhappy with product. Claims it is a fine mist sprayer but it is not. The liquid shoots out in a a stream when u press the top it does not spray in a fine mist as it claims. Would not buy again
Perfect size to have around with alcohol to spray items as needed. Nice misting spray for coverage. Will use for traveling as well
I thought this was one of those continuous misters.  But it works.  Like having more than one.
Perfect for traveling with alcohol , and clean your hands .

reviews.t: Fine mist. Shape of dispenser maybe not good for small hands.
reviews.x: Shape of top of bottle actually makes my finger hurt a bit when I press it to make it spray, OUCH! Maybe if you have longer fingers than mine or tougher, this won’t be a problem for you. I have girls size hands. The spray is a FINE MIST though, so that’s a BIG PLUS.  Son-In-Law says it does not hurt his finger. He does a brilliant job on my two granddaughters hair! Nice that you get enough bottles to share with this purchase!

Works great for traveling and having in office. I use mine with rubbing alcohol instead of using hand sanitizers all the time.  My only complaint is it's hard to find where the spray comes out.  It blends in and is hard to see.  I usually feel for it. It also doesn't come with a little funnel for filling.  I had one already so wasn't a problem for me.  But hard to fill without a funnel.

reviews.t: Great for hand sanitizer and travel
reviews.x: I got these for hand sanitizer spray. I received a large bottle that was a little more liquid than expected, I thought I was getting more of a gel. These are sturdy, nice colors and have an even, fine spray. I added a few drops of essential oil to the sanitizer and it still sprays nicely and smells great. I will use these for travel too, would work well with hair sprays and facial mist

reviews.t: Not terrible, not amazing, but inexpensive
reviews.x: As other reviewers pointed out, it’s difficult at a glance to determine where the spray nozzle is.  One of the four leaks a little as I spray. Since I’m using these for hand sanitizer that’s no problem for my use.  These were inexpensive enough, and my expectations were low. They meet my needs though and were inexpensive.

reviews.t: Stops spraying after a couple of uses!
reviews.x: I love the size and shape of the bottles. At first, they spray perfectly well... after a few times of using, they stop spraying all together. I only needed one, this has happened on 3 out of 4 so far. So I guess I’ll pour my brush cleaner into the 4th one now and at least get a couple uses out of it. Very disappointing!!

These work well to dispense the more liquid version of hand sanitizer, as sold at Cotco in big bottles.  I find they come unscrewed over time.  My work around is to slightly twist to tighten each time I use them.  Friends like the look amd have asked where to buy them.  Pretty, for what they are.

The bottles are great for traveling or keeping in your purse or car. I live that the most is perfect, not to wet and not to dry. The cap stays on really well so that it doesn't accidentally spray. I use it for alcohol spray rather than hand sanitizer. I spray everything.  I love it!

These are very cute, but out of the 4 one of mine came damaged. Secondly only 2 out of the 4 spray a mist, the other two shoot out the product which I don’t know who would want that! I would return but have a baby I don’t want to have to make a trip to ups for $5 and some cents.

Great quality.  Sturdy & Perfect for travel.  Nice colors.  Easy to fill & they do not leak.  Best I’ve seen.  Great packaging.  Each bottle came in it’s on resealable plastic sleeve which I will use as added protection just in case they’re broken during any flights.

the bottles are constructed well and look good. but they leak a lot when spraying. The spray is good. I am using Ethyl Alcohol in the bottles to sanitize stuff and also going to use them for a international trip. it leaks profusely when spraying and hence the rating.

2 of the 4 spray heads don't spray any liquid at all. They pump properly, but nothing sprays out even after multiple attempts. The other 2 needed a few pumps to prime and begin spraying (not unexpected).  They are a nice quality, but useless if they don't work.

I like these little bottles the only problem that I have is that the description said it was for bottles but I only received two and there was no one to answer my messages about the other two that I didn’t receive but the two bottles that I got we’re good

I got these to use for disinfectants/sanitizers however I can’t imagine using a thicker product in them like makeup which it seems to be promoting. Also, they are a bit expensive, imo. Bottom line? They work well for my purposes and I am keeping them.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the bottles for producing a fine, even mist and working well for hand sanitizer, alcohol, and travel.
Several reviewers report the sprayer does not produce a fine mist, instead shooting a thick stream, contrary to the product's claims.
Some reviewers complain that the tops do not stay on securely and that the bottles leak.
Reviewers describe the bottles as sturdy, good-quality plastic rather than flimsy, and well packaged for shipping.
A few reviewers note minor design issues, such as the spray opening being hard to see and the top shape hurting fingers when pressed.
